🔥 पर्दाफाश! आ गया श्रद्धा कपूर की धमाकेदार फिल्म का ग्रैंड ट्रेलर! 🎬

 Maddock Films और Kathputli Creations ने मिलकर Eetha का शानदार ट्रेलर रिलीज कर दिया है। 🌟

 इस एपिक म्यूजिकल ड्रामा में श्रद्धा कपूर एक लावणी लीजेंड 'ईथा बाई' के दमदार किरदार में नजर आ रही हैं। 💃

 फिल्म की कहानी एक ऐसी असाधारण महिला के सफर को दिखाती है जिसने हर चुनौती का सामना कर इतिहास रचा। ✨

 निर्देशन लक्ष्मण उतेकर का है और इसे दिनेश विजयन तथा लक्ष्मण उतेकर ने प्रोड्यूस किया है। 🎥

 क्या आपने यह धमाकेदार ट्रेलर देखा? 🍿

ctx.title: Eetha Trailer Out: Shraddha Kapoor Transforms Into Legendary Eetha Bai
ctx.summary:
The trailer of Eetha offers a glimpse of Shraddha Kapoor’s transformation into legendary Lavani and Tamasha performer Eetha Bai, bringing her remarkable journey to the big screen. 
 The post  Eetha Trailer Out: Shraddha Kapoor Transforms Into Legendary Eetha Bai  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Some stories are told. Some are lived, and some become legends. Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations have unveiled the grand trailer of Eetha, starring Shraddha Kapoor as Eetha Bai.
The epic musical drama inspired by the life of a Lavani legend, the film brings to life the extraordinary journey of a woman who defied conventions, challenged the odds, and rose above every obstacle to carve an unforgettable place in history.
The trailer transports audiences into the vibrant, larger-than-life world of Eetha Bai, where ambition meets adversity, passion becomes power, and every performance tells a story of courage and conviction. Driven by striking visuals, evocative music, and powerful emotions, Eetha promises a cinematic spectacle that celebrates the spirit of an extraordinary artist whose legacy transcends generations. With Shraddha Kapoor stepping into one of her most distinctive roles yet, the film invites audiences to witness a story that demands to be experienced on the big screen.
With Shraddha Kapoor, Laxman Utekar, and a story that ventures into a strikingly different world, Eetha brings together a team driven by a passion for compelling, larger-than-life storytelling. Directed by Laxman Utekar and produced by Dinesh Vijan and Laxman Utekar, Eetha is presented by Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations.
